primary.title: RBI proposes digital payment safeguards: Explained – How customers can control UPI, switch off cards, set payment limits
primary.summary: The RBI has proposed new digital payment safeguards, allowing you to disable UPI and other payment channels, set transaction and daily limits, and switch debit and credit cards on or off. Here is what the draft rules mean for you.
